data.name: Bloodline Powers
data.description: The power of dragons flows through you and manifests in a number of ways. At 1st level, you must select a chromatic or metallic dragon type. Once chosen, this type cannot be changed. A number of your bloodline powers deal damage and grant resistances based on your dragon type.
